title: Chapter summaries (summaries.json), version 1
description: Written by Summaries.save, read by Summaries.load, one file per book that was summarised. A file that cannot be parsed reads as no summaries. The spoken clips are separate files, summary-<index>.m4a, and are not described here. Frozen once released: never edit, add a v2.json.

summaries.description: The chapters summarised so far, in reading order.

index.description: The sentence where the chapter starts.

bullets.description: The key lessons, one per entry.

overview.description: 2 to 3 sentences on the chapter. Absent in a summary made before overviews: reads as empty.

failure.description: Why the last attempt failed, shown with a retry. Absent when the last attempt worked.
